title: Close the Face (Rip It)
style: fast beat, mixed messy jazz, big band phonk back beat, brass hits, female vocal, coaching spoken word, hard groove, call and response, longer than 2 mins
lyrics:
[Intro — heavy brass hit, phonk kick, crowd noise]

(spoken, sharp coach voice)

Paddle face closed.

Contact above the shoulder.

Now RIFF IT!

[Verse 1 — female, hard groove]

Ball coming high off a weak reset

This is the moment — this is the test

Watch it rise, let it reach the peak

Not too early — that's the technique

Weight transfers forward, rotate the hip

Elbow leads, don't let the wrist slip

Backhand loads — shoulder turns back

Then you CLOSE THE FACE AND YOU ATTACK

[Pre-Chorus — brass builds]

The sweet spot lives above your shoulder

Contact there — the point is over

Don't reach up — let the ball drop in

Close the face — now let it rip

[Chorus — full band explosion]

CLOSE THE FACE AND RIP IT

BACKHAND SMASH — DON'T HESITATE

CLOSE THE FACE AND RIP IT

OPTIMAL HEIGHT — YOU OWN THIS SPACE

Paddle face down, elbow high

Contact point — just above the eye

CLOSE THE FACE AND RIP IT

THAT BALL AIN'T COMING BACK

[Verse 2 — coaching breakdown, call and response]

(coach) — Where's the contact?

(player) — Shoulder height!

(coach) — What's the face?

(player) — Closed and tight!

(coach) — Where's the weight?

(player) — Forward drive!

(coach) — What's the finish?

(player) — CROSS COURT RIFF — ALIVE!

Too low — you'll net it, waste the chance

Too high — you lose the angle, lose the stance

The window is tight — just above the chest

Let it rise INTO the zone — then express

Hip rotation — that's the engine

Shoulder turn — that's the ignition

Elbow leads the backhand through

Wrist snap at contact — that's the clue

[Chorus — reprise, harder]

CLOSE THE FACE AND RIP IT

BACKHAND SMASH — DON'T HESITATE

CLOSE THE FACE AND RIP IT

OPTIMAL HEIGHT — YOU OWN THIS SPACE

[Bridge — half-time phonk, coaching over groove]

(spoken, deliberate)

The mistake is rushing.

They lob it — you panic — you reach too early.

Ball's still rising. Wait.

Let it peak.

Shoulder height — that's your trigger.

Now — closed face, hip through, elbow leads.

The smash isn't in the arm.

It's in the rotation.

Drive through the ball.

Don't tap it — COMMIT.

Full swing. Full face. Full rip.

That's the shot.

That's the winner.

[Verse 3 — positioning cues]

If you're at the kitchen — reset the lob

If you're mid court — that's your job

Back foot plants, non-paddle hand drops

Point at the ball — that's where time stops

Paddle loops back behind your ear

Closed face ready — target clear

One fluid motion hip to hand

Best backhand smash in the land

[Final Chorus — biggest, choir + full band]

CLOSE THE FACE AND RIP IT

BACKHAND SMASH — DON'T HESITATE

CLOSE THE FACE AND RIP IT

OPTIMAL HEIGHT — YOU OWN THIS SPACE

Paddle face down, elbow high

Contact point — just above the eye

CLOSE THE FACE AND RIP IT

THAT BALL AIN'T COMING BACK

[Outro — brass fades, spoken]

Closed face.

Optimal height.

Hip through.

Rip it.

Every time.

That's your backhand.
